definitions.explanation: The mutual connection or structural relationship between two or more things. A formal, academic term frequently used in scholarly writing and research to describe how phenomena are linked.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{連関|れんかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a connection between the two incidents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{密接|みっせつ}→密接：12289_missetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{連関|れんかん}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Economics and politics are closely interrelated.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{環境問題|かんきょうもんだい}→環境問題：10136_kankyoumondai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{健康被害|けんこうひがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{連関|れんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{明|あき}らかにしよう→明らかにする：22256_akirakanisuru⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This research aims to clarify the interrelation between environmental problems and health damage.

notes:
A formal, academic term for the mutual connection or interrelation between things. Frequently used in scholarly writing, research, and analysis. More formal than ⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ or ⟦{関連|かんれん}→関連：00177_kanren⟧, with an emphasis on the mutual or structural nature of the connection.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連関|れんかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be connected
- {連関|れんかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to show a correlation
- ⟦{密接|みっせつ}→密接：12289_missetsu⟧な{連関|れんかん}: close interrelation
- ⟦{相互|そうご}→相互：04045_sougo⟧{連関|れんかん}: mutual interrelation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{関連|かんれん}→関連：00177_kanren⟧: relation, connection — more common and less formal
- ⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: relationship — broadest and most everyday term
- ⟦{相関|そうかん}→相関：10001_soukan⟧: correlation — more specifically statistical or quantitative
